data.title: Bitcoin mining shuts down at Dowagiac facility, site plans to covert to AI data center
data.description: After a new deal with its California-based neocloud provider, Hyperscale Data stopped Bitcoin mining in Dowagiac to prepare the facility to transition into an AI data center.
data.keywords: wndu,bitcoin mining dowagiac,dowagiac data center facility,hyperscale data,dowagiac data center
